# ItemComponentReleaseUseEvent Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains information about the release of an item being used through a custom item component.

## Properties

### **itemStack**
`read-only itemStack: ItemStack;`

The item stack that was released.

Type: [*ItemStack*](ItemStack.md)

### **remainingUseDuration**
`read-only remainingUseDuration: number;`

The remaining use duration, in ticks, when the item was released.

Type: *number*

### **source**
`read-only source: Player;`

The player who released the item.

Type: [*Player*](Player.md)
